result.instructions: Tools for Qapla', hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which shipments did we send yesterday, and which of them are still not delivered?"; "Show me the tracking history of order 10482."; "Which couriers can we use for shipments to France?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Qapla' data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run qapla_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run qapla_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run qapla_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. qapla_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: qapla_get_channel
tools.title: Get the channel
tools.description: Get the sales channel behind the API key: its name, platform, URL and company. The key itself is never returned. Qapla' API: GET /1.2/getChannel/.

data.description: Also return the platform and marketplace setup (all, platform or marketplaces).

tools.name: qapla_check_channel
tools.title: Check channel connections
tools.description: Check the connections between the channel and its platform and marketplaces. Qapla' API: GET /1.2/checkChannel/.

tools.name: qapla_get_credits
tools.title: Get remaining credits
tools.description: Get the remaining credits on the premium account. Qapla' API: GET /1.2/getCredits/.

tools.name: qapla_get_shipment
tools.title: Get a shipment
tools.description: Get one shipment and its tracking status by tracking number, order reference or Qapla' id. Give at least one of them. Qapla' API: GET /1.3/getShipment/.

reference.description: The order reference of the shipment.

lang.description: Language of the Qapla' status names (default it).

data.description: Extra blocks, one of: all, consignee, children, parent, flag, notifications, history, rows, parcels, deliveryInfo.

tools.name: qapla_list_shipments
tools.title: List shipments
tools.description: List the shipments imported into the channel for one day. Pick the date field and the day. Qapla' API: GET /1.2/getShipments/.

date_field.description: Date to filter on: shipDate, orderDate or dateIns (upload date). Default: dateIns.

date.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD. Required when date_field is set.

tools.name: qapla_list_company_shipments
tools.title: List company shipments
tools.description: List the shipments of all channels of the company that owns the API key, for one day. Qapla' API: GET /1.3/getCompanyShipments/.

date_field.description: Date to filter on: shipDate, orderDate or dateIns (upload date). Default: dateIns.

date.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD. Required when date_field is set.

data.description: history adds the tracking history of each shipment.

lang.description: Language of the Qapla' status names (default it).

tools.name: qapla_tracking_changes
tools.title: List tracking changes
tools.description: List the shipments whose tracking status changed between two times. Qapla' API: GET /1.2/trackingByTimeFrame/.

dateFrom.description: Start of the window, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

dateTo.description: End of the window, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

lang.description: Language of the Qapla' status names (default it).

tools.name: qapla_list_status_codes
tools.title: List shipment status codes
tools.description: List the Qapla' shipment status codes with their names in one language, or one status by id. Qapla' API: GET /1.2/getQaplaStatus/.

id.description: One status id. Leave empty for all statuses.

lang.description: Language of the Qapla' status names (default it).

tools.name: qapla_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order by its order reference or its alternative order id. Give one of them. Qapla' API: GET /1.3/getOrder/.

tools.name: qapla_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List the orders imported into the channel for one day, or for a time window on updatedAt. Qapla' API: GET /1.2/getOrders/.

date_field.description: Date to filter on: updatedAt, createdAt or dateIns (upload date). Default: dateIns.

date.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD. Required when date_field is set.

dateFrom.description: Window start on updatedAt, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Give with dateTo.

dateTo.description: Window end on updatedAt, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Give with dateFrom.

tools.name: qapla_check_label
tools.title: Check a label
tools.description: Check the state of a shipping label by tracking number, order reference or label id. Qapla' API: GET /1.2/checkLabel/.

tools.name: qapla_get_couriers
tools.title: List couriers
tools.description: List the couriers Qapla' supports, for all countries or for some. Qapla' API: GET /1.2/getCouriers/.

country.description: Comma-separated country codes, for example it,fr,global. Leave empty for all couriers.

code.description: One Qapla' courier code, for example BRT.

tools.name: qapla_detect_courier
tools.title: Detect a courier
tools.description: Guess the courier from a tracking number format. The answer lists candidates, most likely first. It does not check that the tracking number exists. Qapla' API: GET /1.2/detectCourier/.

tools.name: qapla_push_shipments
tools.title: Push shipments
tools.description: Import or update up to 100 shipments in the channel by tracking number and courier. A shipment with the same tracking number and courier is updated, not copied. Each shipment uses one API token of the 150 per 60 s limit. Qapla' API: POST /1.3/pushShipment/.

courier.description: The Qapla' courier code, for example BRT or DHL.

custom1.description: Free field 1, printed on the label when set.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Qapla'
prompts.description: What you can do with Qapla' here, with example requests to try.
